_about: egeria-table.js is pyegeria's renderer for its own structured TABLE result (kind "table"), shipped as package data so the renderer and the shape it draws travel in one release (owner decision D3, 2026-11-14). Its stylesheet is inside the file (EgeriaTable.CSS, injected once). It was first written in the Egeria Portal (origin_* below); pyegeria is now its home: it is edited here FIRST and copied out unchanged to the Portal and trellis-ui (the header comment says so). The only difference from the origin commit is that header paragraph. tests/micro-tests/test_renderer_package_data.py checks the sha256 below and that the file is in the wheel.
differs_from_origin: the 'WHERE THIS FILE IS EDITED' header paragraph only
